base.hashProjection: First 260 entries projected to [English, Korean]; optional metadata excluded.

postSortValidation.historicalRecordSemantics: Existing base, result and method fields record the enrichment snapshot before difficulty sorting and the four follow-up content corrections; their historical hashes and descriptions are retained.
postSortValidation.sourceEntryIndexSemantics: docs/toeic-review.json sources[].rows[].entryIndex is a zero-based index in the pre-difficulty-sort enrichment snapshot. Locate current entries by canonical headword, not this index.
postSortValidation.hashProjection: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify: basePairsSha256 covers original [English,Korean] pairs; wordsSha256 covers all five fields. For both, sort a copied array by normalized English headword using lexicographic string comparison. legacyHeadwordsSha256 covers the sorted normalized headword set with legacy corrections applied. Normalization is NFKC, curly-to-straight apostrophes, collapsed/trimmed whitespace and lowercase.

contentCorrections.ex: The manager criticized the lax safety rules.

senses.hashProjection: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of [headword, senses] for words with a 6th field, sorted like wordsSha256. wordsSha256 covers the first five fields only.

method.layout: [English headword or phrase, Korean meaning, POS, original English example, Korean example translation]
method.existingEntries: Original 260 English/Korean pairs retained unchanged. All 4,132 legacy positions retained; four headword corrections have state aliases in core.js. Documented meaning corrections do not reorder entries.
method.addedOrder: This review appends new entries in case-insensitive alphabetic order. This corpus is not difficulty-ranked; no levels are declared.
method.deduplication: NFKC, whitespace collapse, straight apostrophes, casefold; synonym/antonym annotations removed from headwords.
method.webCoverage: Exhaustive review of all 3,097 numbered/section rows in the three complete web PDFs; every row resolves to an existing or added canonical entry. Overlapping words and spelling/inflection variants share one entry.
method.meanings: Legacy source glosses supplemented or corrected where needed; all new web glosses independently written. Rare/general vocabulary is retained as supplementary content, not claimed to be universally high-frequency TOEIC vocabulary.

meaningCorrections.wear: 입고 있다, 착용하다; 수염 등을 기르고 있다
meaningCorrections.deflate: 공기를 빼다; 물가를 낮추다, 통화를 수축시키다
meaningCorrections.put in place: 마련하다, 시행 준비를 갖추다; 제자리에 두다
meaningCorrections.perceptible: 인지할 수 있는, 알아차릴 수 있는

method.parserException: ad. accepted as the adverb POS for overnight (local PDF page 10).
method.examples: Independently composed short sentences. Reusable semantic sentence frames are used for straightforward senses; verbs, idioms, grammatical patterns and restricted collocations receive authored phrases or individual sentences. Publisher example sentences are not reproduced.
method.qualityChecks: Five nonempty fields; POS code validation; 15-word maximum; target word/inflection/pattern coverage; duplicate and control-character checks; all source rows reconciled. Manual corrections address source POS errors, phrase syntax and unsuitable generic collocations; this is not external expert certification.
